$comment: Shell-owned: the signed-in subject for display — {id, displayName?, email?} or null. `id` is /me's subject_id, the authoritative subject an MFE writes as owner_id; the strings come from the token claims, which only the host can read.

value.$comment: null while the subject is unresolved, and it must validate for the same reason as the organization property: bootstrap seeds it before anything is known.
